segments.he: מַתְנִי׳ מָצָא שִׁטְרֵי חוֹב, אִם יֵשׁ בָּהֶן אַחְרָיוּת נְכָסִים – לֹא יַחְזִיר, שֶׁבֵּית דִּין נִפְרָעִין מֵהֶן. אֵין בָּהֶן אַחְרָיוּת נְכָסִים – יַחְזִיר, שֶׁאֵין בֵּית דִּין נִפְרָעִין מֵהֶן, דִּבְרֵי רַבִּי מֵאִיר.
segments.en: «MISHNA:» With regard to one who «found promissory notes, if they include a property guarantee» for the loan «he may not return» them to the creditor, «as,» if he were to return them, «the court» would then «use them to collect repayment» of the debts from land that belonged to the debtor at the time of the loan, even if that land was subsequently sold to others. If «they do not include a property guarantee, he returns» them to the creditor, «as» in this case «the court» will «not use them to collect repayment» of the debt from purchasers of the debtor’s land. This is «the statement of Rabbi Meir.»

segments.he: וַחֲכָמִים אוֹמְרִים: בֵּין כָּךְ וּבֵין כָּךְ לֹא יַחְזִיר, מִפְּנֵי שֶׁבֵּית דִּין נִפְרָעִין מֵהֶן.
segments.en: «And the Rabbis say:» In «both this» case «and that» case «he should not return» the promissory notes to the creditor, «as,» if he were to return them, «the court» would in any event «use them to collect repayment» of the loan from purchasers of the debtor’s land.

moves.summary: R' Meir: return notes lacking a property guarantee, not those with one
The Sages: do not return them either way

edges.about: whether a found promissory note without a property guarantee is returned to the creditor

positions.claim: notes without a property guarantee are returned; with one, not
positions.basis: the court collects from liened property only with a guarantee

positions.claim: in either case they are not returned
positions.basis: the court collects with them in any case
